knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: 2.1.1
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. (1) For a single policy, you model the number of claims in a fixed year with a constant rare-event rate and independent increments — which discrete family fits, and why? (2) Name one family that would be a habitual mismatch here, and refuse it in one sentence.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: (1) Poisson — counts of rare events in a fixed interval under a constant rate / independent-increments story. (2) Refuse continuous Normal for a non-negative integer count, or refuse hypergeometric if there is no without-replacement draw from a finite success/failure population.
